description: Korean gift tax on a low- or zero-interest family loan (상증법 제41조의4): the benefit is interest at the statutory 4.6% (시행규칙 제10조의5) minus interest actually agreed; it is a gift only when the benefit reaches 10M KRW a year (then the whole benefit, recomputed every year). Returns the benefit, gift tax after the remaining 증여재산공제 and 3% filing credit, the largest interest-free principal (about 217.39M), the lowest safe rate for this principal and the lender's 27.5% withholding on interest received. The principal itself must be a real loan with repayment records.
